title: Poloxamer-based injectable hydrogels as matrices for localized anti-inflammatory drug delivery in meniscus injuries
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21333-21345
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02085B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Marta Tuszynska, Adriana Gonçalves, Joanna Skopinska-Wisniewska, Paula I. P. Soares, Anna Bajek
Poloxamer-based hydrogels are a promising matrix for controlled injectable drug delivery, exhibiting a physiological sol–gel transition, stable pH and osmolarity, and sustained release of diclofenac and paracetamol for osteoarticular injuries.
